rounds.tagline: 3 authentic Victorian Gothic houses built in reality. 1 synthetic haunted manor hallucinated by AI.

cards.title: Carson Victorian Mansion
cards.details: AUTHENTIC ARCHITECTURE. Real 1880s Queen Anne redwood craftsmanship, physically accurate porch columns, and natural daylighting.

cards.title: Lyndhurst Gothic Manor
cards.details: AUTHENTIC ARCHITECTURE. Genuine Gothic Revival limestone masonry, historic mortar joints, and true parkland perspective.

cards.title: The Neural Imposter
cards.details: SYNTHETIC AI. Generative diffusion. Look closely at the fence pickets melting irregularly into the lawn, inconsistent window pane mullions on the upper gables, and surreal non-functional geometry in the gingerbread trim.

cards.title: Winchester Mystery House
cards.details: AUTHENTIC ARCHITECTURE. Physically verified Victorian exterior, authentic California palm trees, and genuine architectural framing.

rounds.tagline: Organic fur and whiskers are a nightmare for AI models. 3 real cats; 1 synthetic machine.

cards.title: Black Cat on Porch
cards.details: AUTHENTIC FELINE. Genuine double-coat fur layering, authentic paw claw anatomy, and natural sunlight coat sheen.

cards.title: Lisbon Black Cat
cards.details: AUTHENTIC FELINE. Individual organic whisker follicles, genuine iris capillary lines, and real wood plank deck perspective.

cards.title: The Neural Imposter
cards.details: SYNTHETIC AI. Diffusion model. Inspect the whisker follicle roots: individual whiskers blend unnaturally into cheek fur without distinct pores, deck wood grain lines warp subtly near paw claws, and corneal reflections lack a true environment.

cards.title: Feline Profile Portrait
cards.details: AUTHENTIC FELINE. Real ear tuft hairs, physically accurate cornea light reflection, and organic micro-fur texture.
